abilities.Arrow.name: Arrow
abilities.Arrow.description: Fire an arrow at an enemy.

abilities.Bite.name: Bite
abilities.Bite.description: Physical damage. On hit, latches onto the target and is dragged along when they move.

abilities.Boomerang.name: Boomerang
abilities.Boomerang.description: Throw a boomerang that bounces between enemies.

abilities.BossCharge.name: Boss Charge
abilities.BossCharge.description: Rush in a straight line, trampling all in the path.

abilities.BossMove.name: Boss Move
abilities.BossMove.description: Move to a nearby tile. Scales with Speed.

abilities.Bullet.name: Bullet
abilities.Bullet.description: Fire a bullet at an enemy.

abilities.ChainLightning.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.ChainLightning.description: Lightning arcs between nearby enemies, weakening with each jump. Scales with Will.

abilities.Charge.name: Charge
abilities.Charge.description: Rush forward, damaging all in your path. Damage scales with Strength, range with Speed.

abilities.Charm.name: Charm
abilities.Charm.description: Beguile an enemy: for 2 turns it fights for your side. Pits your Will against theirs; some minds cannot be swayed.

abilities.Cleave.name: Cleave
abilities.Cleave.description: Hit the target and adjacent enemies in an arc. Scales with Strength.

abilities.EarthShatter.name: Earth Shatter
abilities.EarthShatter.description: Slam the ground in a cone, with a 50% chance to stun each target. Scales with Strength.

abilities.EyeBeam.name: Eye Beam
abilities.EyeBeam.description: Fire a searing beam at a foe in range. Scales with Will.

abilities.Fear.name: Fear
abilities.Fear.description: A dreadful bellow! Nearby enemies flee in terror on their next turn. The heroic may resist; cowards flee longer.

abilities.FireBall.name: Fire Ball
abilities.FireBall.description: Hurl a fireball that ignites an area. Scales with Will.

abilities.FireBomb.name: Fire Bomb
abilities.FireBomb.description: Throw an explosive that ignites an area. Single use.

abilities.FireBreath.name: Fire Breath
abilities.FireBreath.description: Breathe fire in a cone, igniting tiles. Scales with Will.

abilities.FreezeRay.name: Freeze Ray
abilities.FreezeRay.description: Fire a freezing beam that immobilizes the target. Scales with Will.

abilities.FrostBolt.name: Frost Bolt
abilities.FrostBolt.description: Fire an icy bolt. Scales with Will.

abilities.FrostBreath.name: Frost Breath
abilities.FrostBreath.description: Exhale ice in a cone, freezing enemies. Scales with Will.

abilities.Geyser.name: Geyser
abilities.Geyser.description: Launch an enemy with a column of water. Scales with Will.

abilities.Haste.name: Haste
abilities.Haste.description: Grant an ally bonus speed and stamina for 3 turns.

abilities.IceWall.name: Ice Wall
abilities.IceWall.description: Create a wall of ice that blocks movement.

abilities.Inspire.name: Inspire
abilities.Inspire.description: Rally nearby allies: +1 Strength, Luck, Will and Speed for 3 turns, and shakes off fear.

abilities.Leap.name: Leap
abilities.Leap.description: Jump to a tile ignoring obstacles. Scales with Speed.

abilities.MagicBolt.name: Magic Bolt
abilities.MagicBolt.description: A bolt of raw magic. Scales with Will.

abilities.MagicShield.name: Magic Shield
abilities.MagicShield.description: Grant an ally armor for 3 turns. Scales with Will.

abilities.Move.name: Move
abilities.Move.description: Move to a nearby tile. Scales with Speed.

abilities.PhantomArrow.name: Phantom Arrow
abilities.PhantomArrow.description: Conjure a magical arrow that passes through armor. Scales with Will.

abilities.PoisonBomb.name: Poison Bomb
abilities.PoisonBomb.description: Throw a flask that poisons an area. Single use.

abilities.PoisonBurst.name: Poison Burst
abilities.PoisonBurst.description: Spray venom that poisons an area. Scales with Will.

abilities.Resurrect.name: Resurrect
abilities.Resurrect.description: Revive a fallen ally and return them to the fight.

abilities.Sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
abilities.Sanctuary.description: A blessing washes over nearby allies, restoring health. Scales with Will.

abilities.Shock.name: Shock
abilities.Shock.description: Damage all enemies in a cross around you. Scales with Will.

abilities.Sting.name: Sting
abilities.Sting.description: Physical damage. Poisons the target. Scales with Strength.

abilities.Stormpearl.name: Stormpearl
abilities.Stormpearl.description: Hurl a stormpearl that bursts on impact, shoving surrounding mobs back. Knockback scales with will.

abilities.ThrowHarpoon.name: Throw Harpoon
abilities.ThrowHarpoon.description: Hurl a harpoon. Scales with Strength.

abilities.ThrowPearl.name: Throw Pearl
abilities.ThrowPearl.description: Throw a stormpearl that bursts on impact, pushing surrounding mobs back. Single use.

abilities.Thrust.name: Thrust
abilities.Thrust.description: Strike a target up to 2 tiles away. Scales with Strength.

abilities.TonguePull.name: Tongue Pull
abilities.TonguePull.description: Lash out with the tongue and reel the target in.

abilities.Torrent.name: Torrent
abilities.Torrent.description: Blast a target with a jet of water, knocking them back. Scales with Will.

abilities.Web.name: Web
abilities.Web.description: Spit a web that slows the target.

abilities.Whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
abilities.Whirlwind.description: Spin and strike every adjacent tile. Scales with Strength.
